WebSocket and Server-Sent Events (SSE)

WebSocket provides a persistent bidirectional connection; SSE provides a persistent HTTP stream of server-
to-client text events via EventSource. Polling repeatedly makes HTTP requests.
Chat එJක් Jදපැත්තටම real-time messages යවන්න WebSocket සුදුසුයි. Server එJකන් client එකට notifications විතරක් එනවා නම් SSE භාවිත කරන්න පුළුවන්. Connection close සහ reconnect behavior handle කරන්න.

Interview question: When choose SSE instead of WebSocket?
Answer: For primarily one-way server updates where HTTP event streaming is sufficient.
